description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Badge class, which generates SVG images of badges inspired by img.shields.io. It contains a method create_badge that constructs an SVG badge with customizable text and colors.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Badge
classes.description: A class responsible for generating SVG badge images with customizable text and colors.

methods.name: create_badge
methods.description: Creates an SVG badge with specified left and right text content and an optional color for the right part.
